# react-threaded

> Typed Web Workers for React with hooks, hard cancellation, worker pools, shared atomics, plugins, and Comlink-style method proxies. Zero runtime dependencies.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-threaded
Source: https://github.com/hussain-ahmed2/react-threaded
Demo and documentation: https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/

## Core facts

- React 18 or newer, TypeScript 5 or newer, modern browser with Web Workers.
- Workers run from Blob URLs by default, so no bundler-specific worker file is required.
- `useWorker` can start one typed initial task with `autoRun`; parent renders do not rerun it.
- Worker inputs and results use structured clone. Transferables move ownership instead of copying.
- Shared atomics and SharedArrayBuffer require cross-origin isolation: COOP `same-origin` and COEP `require-corp`.
- GitHub Pages cannot set COOP or COEP. The demo detects isolation and falls back from shared atomics.
- A static SPA fallback (`/*` to `/index.html`) is safe only for client-rendered apps. Never add it to Next.js, Waku, RedwoodSDK, or other server-rendered deployments.
- The package has zero runtime dependencies.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs): Installation, concepts, API, frameworks, deployment, and troubleshooting.
- [Getting started](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/getting-started): Install the package and run a typed worker with `createWorker` and `useWorker`.
- [Core concepts](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/concepts): Blob worker execution, serialization, cancellation, transferables, pools, and shared memory.
- [API reference](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/api): Hooks, worker handles, pools, shared atoms, plugins, proxies, and exported types.
- [Troubleshooting](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/troubleshooting): SharedArrayBuffer, cross-origin isolation, CSP, SSR, serialization, and deployment failures.

## Deployment

- [Deployment overview](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/deployment): Headers, MIME types, caching, and SPA fallback rules.
- [Vercel](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/deployment/vercel): `vercel.json`, headers, rewrites, and framework presets.
- [Netlify](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/deployment/netlify): `netlify.toml`, headers, redirects, and Next.js runtime deployment.
- [Cloudflare](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/deployment/cloudflare-pages): Pages, Workers, `_headers`, `_redirects`, and Wrangler.
- [GitHub Pages](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/deployment/github-pages): Base paths, 404 fallback, Actions, and static-only limits.
- [Framework deployment recipes](https://hussain-ahmed2.github.io/react-threaded/docs/deployment/recipes): Exact platform configurations for eight frameworks.
